listened.line: She begged and she pleaded 'til dad finally listened
stanza: She turned fifteen with great expectations
Her older brother knew that somethin' was up
He caught her goin' through his record collection
Lookin' at Hendrix like a lovesick pup
She begged and she pleaded 'til dad finally listened
He drove in the car down to Sears Roebuck
He bought her that guitar and that was the beginnin'
Now she's down in the cellar with the amp turned up

listened.line: It was there I first listened
